# ────────────────────────────────────────── # ACCOUNT — REQUEST SCHEMAS # ──────────────────────────────────────────
AccountCreateRequest: type: object description: Payload for creating a new account required: - name - empId - email - password - companyId properties: name: type: string description: Full name of the employee example: Jane Doe empId: type: string description: Unique employee ID example: EMP-00123 email: type: string format: email description: Employee email address example: jane.doe@company.com password: type: string format: password description: Plain-text password (hashed before storage) example: s3cur3P@ssw0rd companyId: type: string format: uuid description: ID of the UserGroup this account belongs to example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 managerId: type: string format: uuid nullable: true description: ID of the manager's account (optional) example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
AccountUpdateRequest: type: object description: Payload for updating an existing account. Only provided fields are updated. properties: name: type: string nullable: true description: Updated full name example: Jane Smith email: type: string format: email nullable: true description: Updated email address example: jane.smith@company.com password: type: string format: password nullable: true description: New plain-text password (hashed before storage) example: newP@ssw0rd! companyId: type: string format: uuid nullable: true description: ID of the new UserGroup example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 managerId: type: string format: uuid nullable: true description: ID of the new manager, or null to remove manager example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
# ────────────────────────────────────────── # ACCOUNT — RESPONSE SCHEMAS # ──────────────────────────────────────────
AccountResponse: type: object description: Full account details properties: id: type: string format: uuid description: Unique account UUID example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 name: type: string description: Full name of the employee example: Jane Doe empId: type: string description: Unique employee ID example: EMP-00123 email: type: string format: email description: Employee email address example: jane.doe@company.com company: $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserGroupSummary' manager: allOf: - $ref: '#/components/schemas/AccountSummary' nullable: true description: The account's direct manager, or null if none
AccountSummary: type: object description: Lightweight account reference, used when embedding an account inside other responses properties: id: type: string format: uuid example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 name: type: string example: John Manager empId: type: string example: EMP-00001 email: type: string format: email example: john.manager@company.com
# ────────────────────────────────────────── # USERGROUP — REQUEST SCHEMAS # ──────────────────────────────────────────
UserGroupCreateRequest: type: object description: Payload for creating a new user group required: - name - orgId - organisationName properties: name: type: string description: Name of the user group example: Engineering orgId: type: string description: External organisation ID this group belongs to example: ORG-001 organisationName: type: string description: Display name of the organisation example: Lysine Corp
UserGroupUpdateRequest: type: object description: Payload for updating an existing user group. Only provided fields are updated. properties: name: type: string nullable: true description: Updated group name example: Platform Engineering orgId: type: string nullable: true description: Updated organisation ID example: ORG-002 organisationName: type: string nullable: true description: Updated organisation display name example: Lysine Holdings
# ────────────────────────────────────────── # USERGROUP — RESPONSE SCHEMAS # ──────────────────────────────────────────
UserGroupResponse: type: object description: Full user group details properties: id: type: string format: uuid description: Unique UserGroup UUID example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 name: type: string description: Name of the user group example: Engineering orgId: type: string description: External organisation ID example: ORG-001 organisationName: type: string description: Display name of the organisation example: Lysine Corp
UserGroupSummary: type: object description: Lightweight user group reference embedded in account responses properties: id: type: string format: uuid description: UserGroup UUID example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 name: type: string description: Group name example: Engineering organisationName: type: string description: Organisation display name example: Lysine Corp ErrorResponse: type: object description: Standard error response properties: status: type: integer description: HTTP status code example: 404 error: type: string description: Short error label example: Not Found message: type: string description: Human-readable error detail example: Account with id 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 was not found timestamp: type: string format: date-time description: Time the error occurred example: '2024-08-15T10:30:00Z'
